title: A fee is its own spend record linked to its transfer (`of`), with the place the person picked, Free to spend by default (decision S5, answering section 14 question 5)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027 in pesos: the bank holds 20,000.00, of which 2,000.00 is kept for a trip and 3,000.00 is what is left of Free to spend (typed); an e-wallet holds nothing. Pay of 30,000.00 lands in the bank on the 25th (moved earlier) and starts the period; Free to spend is 5,000.00 a month. On Tue 5 Jan the person tops up the e-wallet: 1,015.00 leaves the bank and 1,000.00 arrives. The 15.00 fee is written as its own spend record linked to the top-up (`of`), on the line `fees`, and the person picks the trip money to pay it. On Wed 20 Jan a second top-up costs the same; its fee record names no place, so it is paid from Free to spend. The fee records say which place pays; the money left the bank once, with the top-up's 1,015.00. Every amount is made up.

events.note: the top-up's fee, paid from the trip money (the person's pick)
its fee, no place picked: Free to spend

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 20,000.00 (opening) - 1,015.00 (top-up of Tue 5 Jan, what left the bank) = 18,985.00
asks.note: The fee record is linked to the top-up and moves no money of its own: the bank went down by what left it once [S5, Q2].

asks.question: place
asks.why: 2,000.00 (opening) - 15.00 (the top-up's fee, paid from the trip money) = 1,985.00

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 3,000.00 (Free to spend at the opening, typed; the fee came from the trip money) = 3,000.00
asks.note: Before S5 the fee always came from Free to spend: 2,985.00.
